biography.plain_text: Simon Lawley is a British entrepreneur who founded Go-Pak, a manufacturer and importer of disposable foodservice packaging. Established in 2009 and headquartered in Yate, the business developed paper and plastic factories in Vietnam and supplied customers across Europe and North America. Its sale to SCG Packaging completed in January 2021.

long_biography.plain_text:
Simon Lawley's later investments included lending to Lyphe, a British medical cannabis business. As its principal secured creditor, he established Eezy Group to acquire the business and selected assets in December 2023. The transaction retained most employees and allowed operating subsidiaries to continue serving patients.

Under his ownership, Lyphe combined an online clinic with a dispensing pharmacy, connecting consultations and prescription fulfilment within the same group. Lawley sold the business to Tilray in April 2026, receiving shares in the buyer as part of the consideration. The acquisition brought Lyphe's clinical and dispensing services into Tilray's pharmaceutical supply network.
